row_granularity: The summary table has one row per policy coverage year; the detail loss table has one row per individual claim.
notes: The report contains a coverage/policy summary followed by Detail Loss Report sections. The summary includes policy-year rows, including rows marked No Claims. Detail sections repeat the header with Claimant, Adj Off, FP, Claim Number, Accident Date, Notice Date, Close Date, O/C, Total, Claim, Medical, and Expense. Policy Number(s) appears above each detail claim group rather than as a detail-table column. Detail sections include subtotals for policy number, policy effective date, and line of insurance, followed by report grand totals. Continuation pages repeat the detail header and retain the policy number from the block header.
